_source: CN 1.8.1 client ActionDslCommand/ActionDslEvent + CN's skill scripts (scripts/research/skill_commands_from_pcode.cjs)

ConditionalsFeverMode.label: If in Fever
ConditionalsFeverMode.what: Branch on Fever (inferred: first block in Fever, second not).

ConditionalsHealthPointRatio.label: If HP ≥ X %
ConditionalsHealthPointRatio.what: Branch on the unit's HP: at or above X % runs the first block, else the second.

CreateCondition.label: Buff / debuff
CreateCondition.what: Give a buff or debuff (a condition).

params.label: given again even if it's already on

スペシャルウィーク攻撃力

params.label: who it may go to (1 a unit, 2 the party, 3 either)
(inferred) number by skill level, passed on to each condition

CreateHitArea.label: Attack area
CreateHitArea.what: Create an attack area: the zone that hits.

params.label: id of the hit target (on hit)

CreateNormalAttack.label: Damage
CreateNormalAttack.what: Normal damage to a target (usually inside an area's on-hit).

CreateRatioAttack.label: Damage (% of HP)
CreateRatioAttack.what: Damage as a share of the target's HP (inferred).

CreateRatioHeal.label: Heal
CreateRatioHeal.what: Heal a share of max HP.

CreateReferencePoint.label: Reference point
CreateReferencePoint.what: A point (at a subject, with an offset) areas and effects can attach to or aim at.

FindAllSubjects.label: Find a group
FindAllSubjects.what: Pick a group (the party, all enemies...) and run a block with it.

FindNearSubjects.label: Find the nearest
FindNearSubjects.what: Pick the nearest subjects and run a block with them.

HideCharacter.label: Hide the unit
HideCharacter.what: Hide the unit's sprite for a while.

HideEffect.label: Hide an effect
HideEffect.what: Stop an effect early, by its label.

MoveHitArea.label: Move an area
MoveHitArea.what: Move an attack area (a slash that travels).

StopBall.label: Stop the ball
StopBall.what: Stop or slow the unit's ball for a while.

CollisionOfBallAndEnemy.label: When the ball hits
CollisionOfBallAndEnemy.what: Run the block when the unit's ball hits an enemy (inferred).

CollisionOfBallAndSpecificEnemy.label: When the ball hits (enemy)
CollisionOfBallAndSpecificEnemy.what: Run a block when the ball hits an enemy (inferred).

Repeat.label: Repeat
Repeat.what: Run the block again and again (inferred: every N frames, M times).

Wait.label: Wait
Wait.what: Wait, then run the block (the rest of the script is usually inside it).
